vb_textbox.text: there are gnomes with a bright colour and a darker colour (which lead to different forests). I think at a given time in the game, one shade gives you higher rewards than the other. However, I think the 'better' shade switches every now and then in the game so if the number of mushrooms starts going down, you may want to switch shades. If you are gaining high rewards (5+ mushrooms) then stick with that shade. For clarification, the brighter colours were purpley and red, whilst the darker colours were  dull browns.
